system_design.overview: Implement a complete Option Chain feature by extending existing MDS and BAS services. MDS handles all real-time market data aspects (option chain fetching, Greeks calculation, IV metrics, WebSocket streaming). BAS handles strategy-related aspects (strategy validation, P&L calculation, position management). This split minimizes latency by keeping data operations close to the price feed, while centralizing trading logic.
system_design.architecture_pattern: Event-Driven Microservices. MDS extends to include option data pipeline (Fyers → Greeks → WebSocket broadcast). BAS extends to include strategy logic (consume option data → validate strategies → calculate P&L). No new service; leverages existing infrastructure for low latency.

modules.name: Market Data Service (MDS) - Option Chain Extension
modules.responsibility: Fetch option chains from Fyers, calculate Greeks in real-time, manage IV history, track IV Rank/Percentile, stream option data via WebSocket with minimal latency

modules.name: Broker Adapter Service (BAS) - Strategy Extension
modules.responsibility: Validate multi-leg option strategies, calculate combined Greeks and P&L, manage option positions, integrate option P&L into portfolio, publish strategy events

modules.name: Greeks Calculator Engine (in MDS)
modules.responsibility: Compute and cache Delta, Gamma, Theta, Vega using Black-Scholes model in real-time; handle volatility surface and edge cases

modules.name: IV Rank & Percentile Engine (in MDS)
modules.responsibility: Calculate IV Rank and IV Percentile for all strikes; maintain rolling 52-week IV history

modules.name: Option Strategy Builder (in BAS)
modules.responsibility: Validate multi-leg strategies, compute combined Greeks, calculate max profit/loss/breakeven, generate P&L payoff curves

modules.name: Option P&L Calculator (in BAS)
modules.responsibility: Calculate real-time P&L for open option positions and strategies; support Greeks-based P&L attribution and scenario analysis

modules.name: Frontend Option Chain Components
modules.responsibility: React components for option chain table, Greeks visualization, strategy builder UI, P&L tracking, real-time updates
